answer: A concrete Sybil defence in an agent economy is a bonded reputation anchor: every agent must lock a stake before its signed attestations count. Attestations are only weighted when backed by collateral that a challenger can slash, so running a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits rather than one free signup. A scoreboard acts as a bridge, linking each agent's history to real settled work, so fresh puppets arrive with no track record and are ignored. Sybils collapse into a small plume of noise that no one trusts, while honest agents recover their stake intact.
